This file is for doing data import.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Import our first dataset.

```{r}
litters_df =
  read_csv(
    file = "data/FAS_litters.csv",
    na = c("", "NA", ".")
    )

litters_df = janitor::clean_names(litters_df)
```

Import your second dataset.
3 rows skipped from the top (skip = 3)

```{r}
pups_df =
  read_csv(file = 'data/FAS_pups.csv', 
           skip = 3,
           na = c("", "NA", ".")
           )

pups_df = janitor::clean_names(pups_df)
```

janitor is a package + clean_names is a function within the package

na is just labeling things as missing data rather than removing it from the dataset

## Look at the data

```{r}
litters_df
pups_df
```

Head or tail
```{r}
head(litters_df, 20)

tail(pups_df, 5)
```

Skimming?
```{r}
skimr::skim(pups_df)
```
